name: Tuvalu (1995–1997)
description: A red field with a broad light blue horizontal band edged in white across the middle, a white triangle at the hoist bearing the coat of arms, and eight white five-pointed stars: four on the blue band and two each in the red above and below at the fly.
history: Introduced on 1 October 1995, the seventeenth anniversary of independence, by the government of Prime Minister Kamuta Latasi as a step towards republicanism, dropping the Union Flag and showing eight stars for the eight inhabited islands. The government of Bikenibeu Paeniu restored the independence flag on 11 April 1997 after a 7–5 vote in parliament.

features.role: eight stars for the eight inhabited islands
